problems.reason: Both sentences list the same set of contemporaneous dinosaurs (Adelolophus, Diabloceratops, Lythronax) as co‑habitants of Acristavus, repeating the claim about its environment.

Sentence 5 states the holotype was recovered from the Two Medicine Formation, while sentence 11 claims fossils were found in the Wahweap Formation, giving two different locations for the same species.
Sentence 4 refers to “this region” and “primitive mammals and dinosaurs” without specifying which region or species, leaving the context unclear.

Sentence 4 discusses predator-prey interactions between mammals and dinosaurs in general, not specifically about Acristavus, so it is about something else presented as if it were about the animal itself.
